title: Rat Horoscope 2027: What the Fire Goat Year Means for the Rat
seo_title: Rat Horoscope 2027: Chinese Zodiac Forecast for the Year of the Goat
description: How the Rat is traditionally read in 2027, the Fire Goat year: the Rat's relationship with the Goat, your element by birth year, love and work, the months to watch, and lucky colors and numbers.
lead: 2027 is the year of the Fire Goat, and for the Rat it is a neutral year: tradition gives the Rat no special tie to the Goat, for better or worse. Here is how the Rat is read in 2027, what your birth element adds, and the months to watch.
card_text: The Rat in the 2027 Fire Goat year: love, work, your element by birth year and the months to watch.

sections.h2: The Rat and the Goat year
paras: In the rules our calculators use, the Rat has no traditional relationship with the Goat. It is not in the Goat's triangle (Rabbit, Goat and Pig) and it is not the Goat's opposite, the Ox. A neutral year is usually read as one shaped more by your own choices than by the year's animal.

The Goat year also follows the Horse year of 2026, and the Horse sits directly opposite the Rat, so 2026 was the Rat's clash year. Read that way, 2027 is a calmer stretch after a bumpy one. For a quick-witted, resourceful sign, a slower year is a chance to finish what the Horse year started rather than chase every new opening.
after: 2027 is a Ding-wei year, according to the Hong Kong Observatory: Ding is a Fire stem and Wei is the Goat, so it is the year of the Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027 to 25 January 2028. These are cultural readings, not forecasts: no evidence shows a year's animal decides anyone's luck. Use them as a prompt to think about your own plans.

Born in January or early February? The zodiac year starts at Chinese New Year, so check the start date in the table; if you were born before it, you belong to the sign before the Rat. Our born in January guide and the zodiac checker explain.

sections.h2: Love and relationships for the Rat
paras: The Rat's natural matches in our guide are the Dragon and the Monkey, which share its triangle, and the Ox. A Goat year is usually described as gentle and sociable, which suits relationships built on care more than excitement. The Rat's watch-out is caution with trust: in a warm year it can pay to let people in a little sooner. The Horse, the Rat's opposite, is the pairing tradition marks as the hardest.

sections.h2: Work and money for the Rat
paras: Our guide links the Rat with business, writing, research and trading, work that rewards spotting what others miss. In a year that favours cooperation over speed, openings are more likely to come through people than through quick deals. The Rat's care with money is an asset in any year; 2027 is a good time to put it into a plan rather than a gamble.

Each zodiac year is also divided into twelve zodiac months. Each one starts at a solar term rather than at the new moon, beginning with the Tiger month at Spring Commences (Lichun) on 4 February 2027. sections.h2: Lucky colors, numbers and days for the Rat
paras: In our Rat guide, the Rat's lucky colors are blue, gold, green, its lucky numbers are 2, 3, and its lucky days are Monday and Tuesday. For the full profile, read the Year of the Rat guide; for every sign in 2027, see the 2027 predictions.

faq: Is 2027 a good year for the Rat?
In tradition it is a neutral year: the Rat has no special relationship with the Goat, so the year is read as shaped more by your own choices.
What is the Rat's clash month in 2027?
The Horse month, from 6 Jun to 6 Jul 2027. The Horse is the Rat's opposite sign, and tradition marks its month as the one to take extra care in.
What element is my Rat year?

It depends on the year you were born: 1936 is a Fire Rat; 1948 is an Earth Rat; 1960 is a Metal Rat; 1972 is a Water Rat; 1984 is a Wood Rat; 1996 is a Fire Rat; 2008 is an Earth Rat; 2020 is a Metal Rat.
What are the Rat's lucky colors and numbers?
In our Rat guide: colors blue, gold, green; numbers 2, 3; days Monday and Tuesday.
